1 timed job does not say whether it is time sensitive. A job that sets TIME_INSENSITIVE with setTimeSensitivity() is moved to the maintenance window of the server; whether a job is heavy enough for that only its maintainer knows.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 16 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 106 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
